news.nri_angle: NRIs sending remittances to families in agricultural regions face the prospect of crop failures and food inflation. Rising food and power costs will hit middle-class households across India, while diaspora investors watch the rupee and Indian equities take a double hit from oil and climate risk.

nri-world.nri_angle: Chhetri's career — born in West Bengal, educated in Mumbai and Syracuse, teaching in Cleveland — embodies the transnational literary life the diaspora makes possible.
